mainEntity.name: Will AEO replace traditional SEO for small businesses?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, Answer Engine Optimization is unlikely to completely replace traditional SEO for small businesses; instead, it complements it. Traditional SEO remains crucial for overall website health, organic traffic, and foundational visibility. AEO builds upon this foundation by specifically targeting direct answers from AI search engines and voice assistants. A comprehensive digital marketing strategy for a small business will integrate both, ensuring broad visibility through traditional search rankings while also capturing the growing segment of users seeking immediate, direct answers from AI.
acceptedAnswer.description: AEO will not replace traditional SEO for small businesses; it complements it by targeting direct AI answers, while traditional SEO maintains overall website visibility.
